'''Adder moss''' was a plant originally found on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], but eventually made its way to several other worlds, including [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Adder moss was either burned and used as a natural fuel, or eaten as a spicy, spongy snack. [[Adder moss chips]] were eaten in many [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and [[snack munch bubble]]s.
